name: Harness Capability Registry
description: Evidence-backed release ledger and actor-aware capability graph for agentic harnesses and SDKs.

quality_policy.primary_evidence: Official changelog, release feed, repository, or product documentation.
quality_policy.secondary_evidence: Official cross-vendor compatibility matrices may support but not replace primary evidence.
quality_policy.unknown_rule: Missing evidence is represented as unknown, never inferred as unavailable.
quality_policy.ui_rule: Human UI availability never implies in-harness or external-agent reachability.
quality_policy.promotion_rule: Heuristically extracted release changes remain candidates until reviewed or corroborated by official docs.
